meta.description: Every-2-days auto-poster to Instagram (2-step container->poll->publish) and Facebook Page. Credentials from env via the bedrock-broadcaster-meta ExternalSecret: META_PAGE_TOKEN, IG_ACCOUNT_ID, FB_PAGE_ID. Content rotates deterministically every 2 days across a themed library with layered, rotating hashtags. FB photo posting requires the app to have pages_manage_posts (currently NOT granted -> FB step reports a clear error until added). Images must be publicly reachable (hosted on bedrockbroadcaster.com).
